long: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask is a 3D action-adventure in which Link must prevent the moon from crashing into the land of Termina within a repeating three-day cycle. Using the Ocarina to manipulate time and transformative masks to gain new abilities, players solve dungeons and aid townsfolk. Its dark tone and time-loop mechanics set it apart in the series.
